activity.role: Frankfurt National Assembly deputy and democratic leader
activity.notes: Robert Blum was a leading democratic politician of the 1848 German Revolution and a Leipzig representative in the Frankfurt National Assembly. ATLAS does not model him as ruler of Germany: the German national state had not yet been created, so his Activity is recorded as political activity within the German Confederation and the all-German Frankfurt parliamentary movement.

sources.title: German Bundestag — Robert Blum: Visionär, Demokrat, Revolutionär
sources.citation_text: The Bundestag identifies Blum as a leading politician and speaker of the Paulskirche parliament and records his execution on 9 November 1848.

sources.title: German Bundestag — Revolution and the National Assembly in Frankfurt 1848/1849
sources.citation_text: The Bundestag records the opening of the German National Assembly on 18 May 1848 and its role in attempted German unification.
